purpose: Build an auditable bank of independent driving events before Stage2-L UQ-language grounding and Stage2-P planning training.

responsibility_boundary.stage1_adapter: Frozen, task-agnostic spatial observation uncertainty only.
responsibility_boundary.uq_tokenizer: Preserve view, position, magnitude and temporal structure without route, TTC, collision or corruption-family inputs.
responsibility_boundary.orion_vlm: Predict task relevance and a human-readable QA explanation from visual, route and UQ context.
responsibility_boundary.trajectory_decoder: Consume task-relevant risk only after Stage2-L passes its semantic and causal gates.

screening_runtime.port_policy: Ten-port CARLA and traffic-manager lanes derived from SLURM_JOB_ID.

selection_policy.development_screen: May use published ORION outcomes and current clean replay outcomes to find useful training/development events.
selection_policy.locked_test: May use static scenario geometry and current clean runtime validity only; must not be selected based on learned-UQ or Stage2 behavior.
selection_policy.locked_test_freeze: Route identities are frozen before any ORION outcome, learned-UQ, or Stage2 result is read. After replay, a route may be excluded only for attested runtime, sensor, map, spawn, or visualization integrity failure; model success or failure is not an exclusion criterion.
selection_policy.split_unit: Whole route and event; adjacent frames from one event never cross splits.
selection_policy.corruption_split_unit: Whole corruption family for the formal unseen-family evaluation.

critical_event_priority: minimum finite dynamic-actor OBB separating-axis gap
no automatic event when actor-grounded geometry is absent

automatic_exclusion: required camera or BEV stream absent
required_human_checks: absence of actor disappearance or spawn artifacts

formal_training_locked_until: at least 8 independent pilot events span at least 3 Towns and 4 scenario families
QA leakage, balance and map-text consistency audits pass

claim_boundary: Scenario discovery and QA construction are development-data operations. They do not establish adapter validity, VLM semantic understanding or closed-loop safety until their independent gates pass.
